text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Today, I had plans to go out with Buena Vista.
Our destination was...”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Waah, it's so lively!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for keeping your promise from the other day.
Let's have tons of fun today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The other day, I realized I had "less and less private time." So I decided to visit an amusement park a bit further away, but...
choice_data_list: (I could stay here all day... Huh?)

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, isn't that Buena-chan?
—Daddy, look! Buena Vista!
—I'm a huge fan! Can I get a picture!?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista was surrounded by fans in the blink of an eye!
It took several dozen minutes for things to finally calm down...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: It's incredible...! To think there are so many people cheering for us...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But sorry for keeping you waiting, okay?
Even though you went out of your way
to set aside some private time for us.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Besides... if a huge crowd suddenly gathers,
it might block the way...
That could be a bit dangerous... right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista looked a bit troubled.
However, she had found something great
at the merchandise stand just a moment ago.
choice_data_list: If you'd like, please take this...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh, could this be...!
............

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I wondered what was going on... *giggle*!
Takes me back.
We used to do this 'Disguise Operation' back in the day, too."
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah, that did happen—
Ah, right, that happened too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I was little, I had a similar troublesome experience while walking around the neighborhood—

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Bye-bye, everyone!
Ehehe... everyone's smiling...!
But... wheeeewww...
choice_data_list: Buena... did you get a little tired?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Buu-chan, it was fun, but...
looking here and there... made my head spin...
choice_data_list: That's it... All right, let's wear disguises!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"A dis-guise? I know dat...!
It's the thing that makes you secret...!"
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's make it so only the two of us understand.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing...! Then, then... um.
Just the two of us in the whole wide world!?
choice_data_list: "The world"...?! Ahaha, but you're right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I walked around wearing gaudy toy glasses, masks, and ear covers,
but that just made me stand out even more,
and people talked to me even more...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Ahahaha!
It was a huge blunder, you know.
I ended up bawling like a baby...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it looks like it'll be fine this way.
Things aren't like they were back then anymore."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
"Just the two of us in the world today"... right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The strategy was a success,
and nobody found us after that.
We were able to spend a peaceful time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We were transferring between buses to get to a restaurant with a scenic view... However...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Suspended due to road race competition"...?
Huh...?! Was there an announcement about that?
choice_data_list: No, there's no information like that on the internet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, this flyer is the only notice they gave.
Catching a cab out here seems unlikely, too.
Just as I was wondering what to do...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Alright, shall we walk?
Only if that's okay with you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Of course it's okay...! But, sorry—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You don't need to apologize.
It couldn't be helped, after all.
Come on, let's go—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without the slightest hint of displeasure, she began to walk.
That's right... she always smiles, especially in difficult times like these—

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Stay calm for tomorrow's written exam...!
Tracen Academy focuses mainly on practical exams, but you still can't let your guard down...!"
choice_data_list: W-w-wait, don't forget anything, okay...!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both for worrying about me.
I've checked everything again and again, so I'll be fine.
With everyone's support, I don't feel any anxiety at all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll do it!
Now that I've come this far, all that's left is to believe in myself."
choice_data_list: Buena...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While everyone around her panicked, she stayed calm. Not losing a wink of sleep, she woke up early... and brilliantly passed!
choice_data_list: Like I said before, you're strong at your core, you know.
Like I said before, you have a strong core, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu... What brought this on all of a sudden?
choice_data_list: It just came to me while I was out walking.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I see... But I think I get it.
Walking down a quiet, empty road like this really brings back memories, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then, we walked while sharing our memories.
The slope that had looked so daunting was surprisingly fun,
and led us to a place with a breathtaking view..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Waaah...!
To think there was a place like this in the neighborhood...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
............It's beautiful.
Every single flower is so full of life...
It's almost like they're smiling at me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching her looking deeply moved, I was reminded of what happened the other day. She truly has a pure heart.
choice_data_list: Remember when I talked to you about your strengths before?
Remember when I talked to you about your strengths before?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Yeah, you helped me with that assignment.
I already turned it in, though...
Wait, have you been worrying about it this whole time?
choice_data_list: No, it just suddenly came back to me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you never ended up telling me back then, did you?
To be honest, I was a little curious.
choice_data_list: You really have... such a pure heart.
You really have such a pure heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What made me think that wasn't just what I saw now.
For instance, it was something that happened right after I arrived at the academy—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, clear the track already!
—Excuse me?! I've got a race coming up too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps due to the harsh environment, it wasn't uncommon for Umamusume to be on edge. That was why I grew worried about Buena Vista, who had wandered off.
choice_data_list: (I hope she hasn't been overwhelmed by this atmosphere...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“—I will do my absolute best in today's mock race.
Let's have a great run, everyone!”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, well look who it is, the favorite.
I'm definitely gonna wipe that smirk off your face.
Before you came along, I was the one in the spotlight...!
choice_data_list: (Buena... I hope she's okay?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the gates opened.
Buena Vista...
suffered a heartbreaking defeat.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hah, how's that!
Your sparkling stuff isn't all that—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! It's a complete defeat.
How can you run so fast?
Um... if it's alright, please tell me all about it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Sorry for blurting that out.
I just got too excited...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wha...!? What's with you!
Aren't you even frustrated...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it's frustrating...
But more than that, I want to learn from her.
Her run was just so incredible...!
choice_data_list: (Ahh, she hasn't changed a bit...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Thinking that, I felt relieved.
She would never be tainted.
I had thought so whenever I saw her like this, since long ago.
choice_data_list: You're truly so pure and radiant.
You're truly so pure and radiant.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
So that's what you thought of me.
I'm a little surprised.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Somehow, um... ehehe...
Maybe it's just a little hot today...?
